description: Monitor options of the platformio.ini [env] section.

# Monitor options

Default settings of the serial monitor for this environment.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`monitor_port`](./monitor-port.md) | A port, a number or a device name |
| [`monitor_speed`](./monitor-speed.md) | A monitor speed (baud rate) |
| [`monitor_parity`](./monitor-parity.md) | A monitor parity checking |
| [`monitor_filters`](./monitor-filters.md) | Apply the filters and text transformations to monitor output |
| [`monitor_rts`](./monitor-rts.md) | A monitor initial RTS line state |
| [`monitor_dtr`](./monitor-dtr.md) | A monitor initial DTR line state |
| [`monitor_eol`](./monitor-eol.md) | A monitor end of line mode |
| [`monitor_raw`](./monitor-raw.md) | Disable encodings/transformations of device output |
| [`monitor_echo`](./monitor-echo.md) | Enable a monitor local echo |
| [`monitor_encoding`](./monitor-encoding.md) | Custom encoding (e.g. hexlify, Latin-1, UTF-8) |
